title: Update on the discord issues for anyone who may have understandably left the server recently…
content: I will be setting up a new private server for anyone who has been active in the past on the discord, please just send me a message on discord from your original account and I will keep you updated on what’s going on. The idea is to recreate the functionality of the old server without the issues that stemmed from it being completely open to everyone who wanted to create a new account.
